data.summary: go-templated YAML record 'deployment.yaml' with 1 document(s) and 25 block(s).

blocks.data:
# spec
spec:

# spec.template
  template:

# spec.template.spec
    spec:

# spec.template.spec.containers
      containers:

# spec.template.spec.containers[0]
        - name: {{ .Chart.Name }}

# spec.template.spec.containers[0]
          securityContext:
            {{- toYaml .Values.securityContext | nindent 12 }}
          image: {{ include "pipeshub-ai.image" (dict "image" .Values.image "global" .Values.global) | quote }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy | default .Values.global.imagePullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - name: main
              containerPort: 8091
              protocol: TCP
            - name: connector
              containerPort: 8088
              protocol: TCP
            - name: backend
              containerPort: 3001
              protocol: TCP
            - name: query
              containerPort: 8000
              protocol: TCP
            - name: indexing
              containerPort: 8081
              protocol: TCP
            {{- if .Values.metrics.enabled }}
            - name: metrics
              containerPort: {{ .Values.metrics.port }}
              protocol: TCP
            {{- end }}

# spec.template.spec.containers[0].env
          env:

# spec.template.spec.containers[0].env
            - name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
              value: {{ .Values.config.allowedOrigins | quote }}
            - name: SAML_SP_ENTITY_ID
              value: {{ .Values.config.samlSpEntityId | default .Values.config.frontendPublicUrl | default "pipeshub" | quote }}
            
            # Security settings
            - name: SECRET_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "pipeshub-ai.secretName" . }}
                  key: secret-key
            
            # Public endpoints
            - name: CONNECTOR_PUBLIC_BACKEND
              value: {{ .Values.config.connectorPublicBackend | quote }}
            - name: FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL
              value: {{ .Values.config.frontendPublicUrl | quote }}
            
            # Internal service URLs
            - name: QUERY_BACKEND
              value: "http://localhost:8000"
            - name: CONNECTOR_BACKEND
              value: "http://localhost:8088"
            - name: INDEXING_BACKEND
              value: "http://localhost:8091"
            - name: EMBEDDING_SERVER_URL
              value: "http://localhost:8002"
            
            {{- if .Values.etcd.enabled }}
            # ETCD config
            - name: ETCD_URL
              value: "http://{{ include "pipeshub-ai.fullname" . }}-etcd:2379"
            - name: ETCD_HOST
              value: "{{ include "pipeshub-ai.fullname" . }}-etcd"
            {{- end }}

# spec.template.spec.containers[0].env
            
            {{- if .Values.arango.enabled }}
            # ArangoDB config
            - name: ARANGO_URL
              value: "http://{{ include "pipeshub-ai.fullname" . }}-arango:8529"
            - name: ARANGO_DB_NAME
              value: "es"
            - name: ARANGO_USERNAME
              value: "root"
            - name: ARANGO_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "pipeshub-ai.arangoSecretName" . }}
                  key: arango-password
            {{- end }}
            {{- if and .Values.arango.enabled (not .Values.neo4j.enabled) }}
            - name: DATA_STORE
              value: "arangodb"
            {{- end }}
            {{- if .Values.neo4j.enabled }}
            # Neo4j config (app uses Neo4j as graph DB when DATA_STORE=neo4j)
            - name: DATA_STORE
              value: "neo4j"
            - name: NEO4J_URI
              value: "bolt://{{ include "pipeshub-ai.fullname" . }}-neo4j:7687"
            - name: NEO4J_USERNAME
              value: {{ .Values.neo4j.auth.username | quote }}
            - name: NEO4J_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "pipeshub-ai.neo4jSecretName" . }}
                  key: neo4j-password
            - name: NEO4J_DATABASE
              value: {{ .Values.neo4j.auth.database | quote }}
            {{- end }}
            
            # Message broker config
            - name: MESSAGE_BROKER
              value: {{ .Values.messageBroker.type | default "redis" | quote }}

# spec.template.spec.containers[0].env
            - name: REDIS_STREAMS_MAXLEN
              value: {{ .Values.messageBroker.redisStreamsMaxLen | default "500000" | quote }}

            {{- if eq .Values.messageBroker.type "kafka" }}
            # Kafka config
            - name: KAFKA_BROKERS
              value: "{{ include "pipeshub-ai.fullname" . }}-kafka:9092"
            {{- end }}
            
            # Redis config
            {{- /*
              Connection target:
                - standalone or replication (no sentinel), redis.external.enabled=false (default):
                  use the Bitnami "<release>-redis-master" Service. This is a stable Service that the
                  chart updates to follow the current master pod, so the app does not need Sentinel
                  awareness.
                - sentinel enabled: the app MUST use a Sentinel-aware client. The chart still exposes the
                  master Service for compatibility, but failover updates may lag and stale connections are
                  possible. Enable Sentinel only if the app is migrated to a Sentinel client.
                - redis.external.enabled=true: point at redis.external.clusterEndpoints (a self-hosted
                  Redis Cluster or AWS MemoryDB, R21/R22) instead of the bundled subchart -- pair with
                  redis.mode=cluster and --set redis.enabled=false to skip deploying the subchart
                  entirely (wired via the `condition: redis.enabled` dependency in Chart.yaml).
            */}}
            {{- include "pipeshub-ai.validateRedis" . }}
            {{- if .Values.redis.external.enabled }}
            - name: REDIS_HOST
              value: ""
            - name: REDIS_PORT
              value: "6379"
            - name: REDIS_CLUSTER_ENDPOINTS
              value: {{ .Values.redis.external.clusterEndpoints | quote }}
            - name: REDIS_CLUSTER_NAT_MAP
              value: {{ .Values.redis.external.natMap | default "" | quote }}
            {{- else }}
            - name: REDIS_HOST
              value: "{{ .Release.Name }}-redis-master"
            - name: REDIS_PORT
              value: "6379"
            {{- end }}

# spec.template.spec.containers[0].env
            
            # MongoDB config
            {{- $isReplicaSet := eq (.Values.mongodb.architecture | default "standalone") "replicaset" }}
            {{- $mongoHost := ternary (printf "%s-mongodb-headless" .Release.Name) (printf "%s-mongodb" .Release.Name) $isReplicaSet }}
            {{- $mongoRsParam := ternary (printf "&replicaSet=%s" (.Values.mongodb.replicaSetName | default "rs0")) "" $isReplicaSet }}
            {{- if .Values.mongodb.auth.enabled }}
            - name: MONGO_USERNAME
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "pipeshub-ai.mongodbSecretName" . }}
                  key: mongodb-username
            - name: MONGO_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "pipeshub-ai.mongodbSecretName" . }}
                  key: mongodb-password
            - name: MONGO_URI
              value: "mongodb://$(MONGO_USERNAME):$(MONGO_PASSWORD)@{{ $mongoHost }}:27017/?authSource=admin{{ $mongoRsParam }}"
            {{- else }}
            - name: MONGO_URI
              value: "mongodb://{{ $mongoHost }}:27017/{{ if $mongoRsParam }}?{{ trimPrefix "&" $mongoRsParam }}{{ end }}"
            {{- end }}
            - name: MONGO_DB_NAME
              value: "es"
            # Single source of truth: tied to mongodb.architecture so this env var
            # cannot drift from the rendered MONGO_URI. Overriding architecture
            # alone (e.g. --set mongodb.architecture=standalone) used to leave
            # REPLICA_SET_AVAILABLE=true and crash the API at first transaction.
            - name: REPLICA_SET_AVAILABLE
              value: {{ ternary "true" "false" $isReplicaSet | quote }}
            
            # Qdrant config
            - name: QDRANT_API_KEY
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ include "pipeshub-ai.qdrantSecretName" . }}
                  key: qdrant-api-key
            - name: QDRANT_HOST
              value: "{{ include "pipeshub-ai.fullname" . }}-qdrant"

# spec.template.spec.containers[0].env
            - name: QDRANT_GRPC_PORT
              value: "6334"
            - name: QDRANT_PORT
              value: "6333"

            # Vector DB collection layout. Only read on the first startup that
            # finds nothing persisted; from then on the stored value wins, and a
            # value here that contradicts it fails startup — points already sit
            # in collections a different strategy would not resolve.
            - name: VECTOR_COLLECTION_STRATEGY
              value: {{ .Values.vectorDb.collectionStrategy | default "single" | quote }}

            - name: HOME
              value: /home/user
            
            {{- if .Values.telemetry.enabled }}
            # OpenTelemetry configuration
            - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
              value: {{ required "telemetry.otlp.endpoint is required when telemetry.enabled is true" .Values.telemetry.otlp.endpoint | quote }}
            {{- if .Values.telemetry.otlp.tls.insecure }}
            - name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_INSECURE
              value: "true"
            {{- end }}
            {{- end }}

# spec.template.spec.containers
        {{- if .Values.sandbox.dind.enabled }}
        # Docker-in-Docker: gives SANDBOX_MODE=docker a daemon, so
        # model-generated code runs in a throwaway container instead of as a
        # subprocess of the application. See `sandbox.dind` in values.yaml for
        # the privilege trade this makes.
        - name: dind
          image: {{ .Values.sandbox.dind.image | quote }}
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.sandbox.dind.pullPolicy | quote }}
          securityContext:
            # The daemon needs to create namespaces, mount filesystems and
            # manage cgroups, which no unprivileged container can do. This
            # deliberately overrides the pod-level runAsNonRoot.
            privileged: true
            runAsNonRoot: false
            runAsUser: 0
          env:
            # TLS off because the listener is bound to loopback below and
            # never leaves the pod's network namespace. That binding is what
            # makes it safe: 0.0.0.0 would also bind the pod IP, publishing
            # an unauthenticated root-equivalent API to anything on the
            # cluster network that can route to this pod.
            - name: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR
              value: ""
          args:
            - "--host=tcp://127.0.0.1:{{ .Values.sandbox.dind.port }}"
            - "--host=unix:///var/run/docker.sock"
          resources:
            {{- toYaml .Values.sandbox.dind.resources | nindent 12 }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: dind-storage
              mountPath: /var/lib/docker
          livenessProbe:
            exec:
              command: ["docker", "info"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 20
            periodSeconds: 30
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 3
          startupProbe:
            # Pulling the sandbox image on a cold cache can take a while;
            # this is what stops a slow first start being read as a crash.
            exec:
              command: ["docker", "info"]
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 10
            failureThreshold: 30
        {{- end }}

# spec.template.spec.containers
          {{- with .Values.nodeSelector }}
